# Florence 1490 – Life sciences

K = knowledge level · use = none/wrong/partial/correct · make = producibility with local means · accept = acceptance.

- **Microorganisms (living things too small to see)** [`microorganisms`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/microorganisms.md) — K0, use none, make medium, accept medium. Needs the single-lens microscope first. What is seen will be read as spontaneously generated worms, a sign of putrefaction rather than its cause.
- **Life comes only from life (spontaneous generation refuted)** [`spontaneous_generation_refuted`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/spontaneous_generation_refuted.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept medium. Aristotle and everyone else: maggots come from rotting meat, eels from mud, bees from ox carcasses (Virgil). Covered-jar experiment is cheap and convincing.
- **Fermentation is the work of living yeast** [`fermentation_yeast`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/fermentation_yeast.md) — K0, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Bakers preserve sourdough and vintners work with fermenting must. They use living cultures without recognising yeast as the organism responsible. Local: vintners; bakers.
- **Cell theory** [`cell_theory`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/cell_theory.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept low. Bodies are made of humours and uniform parts (flesh, bone). Needs a good microscope and thin sections; no practical use people can see.
- **Viruses (disease agents smaller than bacteria)** [`viruses`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/viruses.md) — K0, use none, make impossible, accept low
- **Systematic classification and naming of living things** [`taxonomy`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/taxonomy.md) — K2, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Plants are known through Dioscorides, Pliny and Theophrastus (Latin 1483); humanists argue about which local herb matches which ancient name. Apothecaries substitute freely. No botanical garden yet. Local: apothecaries; monastery herb gardens; Medici villa gardens (Careggi). Elsewhere: Ferrara, Niccolò Leoniceno.
- **Egg, sperm and fertilisation** [`reproduction_fertilisation`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/reproduction_fertilisation.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept low. Aristotle: male seed gives form to menstrual blood; Galen: both sexes give seed. Mammal eggs and sperm are invisible without a microscope. Touches theology (ensoulment).
- **Heredity by discrete factors (Mendel)** [`heredity_genetics`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/heredity_genetics.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept medium. Farmers and breeders recognise inherited traits. Testing ratios across multiple generations takes careful records. Annual crops limit the evidence a garden can yield in one year.
- **Evolution by natural selection** [`evolution_natural_selection`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/evolution_natural_selection.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. A breeder can show inherited variation and selection. Extending the argument to the origin of species challenges familiar accounts of Creation.
- **DNA is the hereditary material (double helix)** [`dna_structure`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/dna_structure.md) — K0, use none, make impossible, accept low
- **Breathing is slow combustion (respiration and body heat)** [`respiration_metabolism`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/respiration_metabolism.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept low. Galen: breathing cools the heart's innate heat and feeds vital spirit. A mouse and a candle under a bell jar both die: easy to show, hard to explain.
- **Plants are built from air, water and light (photosynthesis and mineral nutrition)** [`photosynthesis_plant_nutrition`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/photosynthesis_plant_nutrition.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept medium. In 1450 Cusanus proposed weighing soil before and after growing plants and attributed their gain to water. The role of carbon dioxide remains unknown.
- **Legumes fix nitrogen from the air (root nodule bacteria)** [`nitrogen_fixation_biology`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/nitrogen_fixation_biology.md) — K2, use partial, make easy, accept medium. That lupins and beans 'fatten' the soil is read in Columella and Crescenzi and done by good farmers. Why is unknown; the nodules are taken for a disease. Local: Pier de' Crescenzi's Ruralia commoda (Florence edition in Italian, 1478).
- **The brain and nerves (seat of thought, electrical signalling)** [`nervous_system_brain`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/nervous_system_brain.md) — K2, use partial, make hard, accept medium. Galen's view holds: brain and nerves, with animal spirits flowing through hollow nerves; faculties sit in the ventricles. Aristotelians still favour the heart. Electrical signalling is unprovable here.
